name: Son Of God
overview: The Bible clearly teaches that Jesus is the Son of God, a truth affirmed from the Old Testament declaration in Psalms 2:7 where God proclaims, 'Thou art my Son.' This divine sonship is uniquely embodied in Jesus, as the angel explains in Luke 1:35, affirming that the Holy Spirit's power will bring forth the holy Son of God. John 3:16 further reveals the profound love of God in giving His only begotten Son for the salvation of believers, highlighting Jesus' unique and eternal relationship with the Father. Additionally, Romans 8:14 distinguishes true children of God as those led by the Spirit, setting Jesus apart as the singular Son in a unique and divine sense.
